question_text: A 71-year-old woman comes to the physician because of an 8-month history of fatigue. Laboratory studies show a hemoglobin concentration of 13.3 g/dL, a serum creatinine concentration of 0.9 mg/dL, and a serum alkaline phosphatase concentration of 100 U/L. Laboratory evaluation of which of the following parameters would be most helpful in determining the cause of this patient's symptoms?
